description.value: Section {$sectionName} (LOINC {$sectionCode}): the {$resourceType} of the {$entryName} entry has {$element}.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is {$resourceType} and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '{$sectionCode}').exists()).entry[{$entryIndex}].reference or ('{$resourceType}/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '{$sectionCode}').exists()).entry[{$entryIndex}].reference)).resource.where({$elementCondition}).exists()
